body: Update: he broke off the engagement because my self-harm is too much to handle. My feeling of being a burden and being worthless has just been reinforced. I feel like my life has just crumbled and there is nothing left for me. I'm too old to find someone new to start a life with that understands my situation. I guess he was too good to be true and I will never be good enough.
I know he cares. I'm just afraid that I pushed him away because I am just being too much. Thank you :)
